description: This file defines an interface for building responses and events related to the DeleteFeatureProperty command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested interfaces for response and event factories, which generate command responses and delete events, respectively.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for DeleteFeatureProperty commands.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses, such as successful deletion or error responses.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events triggered by DeleteFeatureProperty commands.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a response indicating successful deletion of the feature property.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature property was not accessible.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature property was not modifiable.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a FeaturePropertyDeleted event for the DeleteFeatureProperty command.
